QUESTIONS?

Frequently Asked Questions

Here are a few things to know before getting in touch.

How do I book an appointment?

Please call +91 96697 66111 to ask about availability, or send your details using the WhatsApp consultation form.

What should I bring to my consultation?

Bring any relevant medical reports, X-rays or scans, a list of medicines, and the questions you would like to discuss.

Are teleconsultations available?

Please call the clinic to ask about current consultation options and whether an in-person examination may be needed.

What insurance plans are accepted?

Call the clinic to check current insurance and payment arrangements for your visit.
